Name: TC_Catalogue_Search by ISBN
Description: Search the catalogue by full ISBN.
Precondition: The catalogue holds at least 500 titles.
Test Step Description: Log in to the library system as a member of staff
Test Step Expected Result: The home page shows the user name in the header
The search mask is displayed with an empty input field
Exactly one hit is shown with title, author and shelf mark
The login page is displayed

Name: TC_Catalogue_Search with a wildcard
Precondition: The catalogue holds at least 500 titles.
Test Step Description: Log in to the library system as a member of staff
Test Step Expected Result: The home page shows the user name in the header

Test Step Description: Enter Northwind* in the title field and confirm
Test Step Expected Result: Every title starting with Northwind is listed alphabetically
The login page is displayed

Name: TC_Lending_Lend an available item
Description: Lending an available item to an active member.
Precondition: Member 100234 is active and owes no fees.
Test Step Description: Log in to the library system as a member of staff
Test Step Expected Result: The home page shows the user name in the header
The member account is shown with name and current loans
The loan is booked and a return date four weeks out is set
The login page is displayed

Name: TC_Lending_Loan limit per member
Description: A further loan is refused once the limit is reached.
Precondition: Member 100234 already has nine items on loan.
Test Step Description: Log in to the library system as a member of staff
Test Step Expected Result: The home page shows the user name in the header
The loan is booked
The loan is refused and the message Loan limit reached is shown
The login page is displayed

Name: TC_Members_Date of birth is mandatory
Description: A member account without a date of birth is not saved.
Test Step Description: Log in to the library system as a member of staff
Test Step Expected Result: The home page shows the user name in the header

Test Step Description: Create a member without a date of birth
Test Step Expected Result: The field is empty and marked as mandatory
The account is not saved and the message Date of birth is mandatory is shown
The login page is displayed

Name: TC_E2E_From the catalogue to the return
Description: End-to-end flow across search, lending, renewal and return.
Precondition: A staff account and an active member are available.
Test Step Description: Log in to the library system as a member of staff
Test Step Expected Result: The home page shows the user name in the header

Test Step Description: Find the item K-4711 in the catalogue
Test Step Expected Result: Exactly one hit is shown with the status Available
The loan is booked and a return date is set
The return date moves two weeks later
The status returns to Available and the member account is clear
The login page is displayed

Name: TC_E2E_Late return and fee
Description: End-to-end flow for calculating a late fee.
Precondition: An overdue loan exists for member 100234.
Test Step Description: Log in to the library system as a member of staff
Test Step Expected Result: The home page shows the user name in the header
A late fee is calculated and charged to the member account
The member account is clear and a receipt is produced
The login page is displayed
